interpretation.record_granularity: Individual directory entries, rooms, buildings, sites and collections retain separate records until their identities are reconciled.
interpretation.identity: Public directory identifiers are distinct from the County or FEA asset-register identifiers used for an authoritative client import.
interpretation.as_of: A null as_of value means the published page does not state an effective date. Acquisition time is recorded separately.
interpretation.ownership: Maintenance or use does not establish title. The School District gym owner and the County lease at 735 US Highway 24 are recorded explicitly.
interpretation.assessment: The descriptions and historical work provide public context. They do not supply a current professional condition assessment, valuation, replacement cost or remaining service life.
interpretation.budget: Keep the source, fiscal year and table label with each amount. The 2026 book introduction says adopted, while its tables and annual budget page retain preliminary labels. Historical 2025 account rows do not establish available cash in 2026 or 2027.
interpretation.funding: The June 2026 anticipated DOLA award, requested County contribution and proposed project total retain separate statuses. A combined funding calculation must not count both the total and its components.
interpretation.lease: The approximate USD 110,000 rate is per department per year as of August 2026. The renewal request does not establish executed new terms.
interpretation.scenario: The current RFP requires a 15-year capital needs forecast. Five- and ten-year summaries can show portions of the same forecast. FEA retains responsibility for professional models, assessments and appraisals.
interpretation.commercial: The original first contact to FEA was sent at 11:17:27 UTC. This source contribution belongs to that existing company case.
interpretation.gis: The official County Mapping page provides an open-data download portal. The collector reads its anonymous public catalog and selected infrastructure and recreation layers. All feature identifiers, attributes, geometry, catalog pages, service metadata and source dates remain with the observations.
interpretation.capital_rollforward: The 2024 audited Note 5 rollforward records historical accounting balances. Components reconcile to USD 36,381,116 of governmental net capital assets at December 31, 2024. Keep gross balances, accumulated depreciation, lease assets and subtotal rows separate when calculating summaries.
interpretation.harrison: The December 2024 Harrison Park FAQ, August 2024 environmental-review RFP and prior master-plan package retain their own dates. The County property, the adjacent School District strip, historical field condition and Regional Housing Authority grant each retain separate records.

integration.execution: For this complete application invocation, set FEA_PUBLIC_SOURCE_SAVE_MODE=embedded. Run acquisition, import the source-linked observations, complete the application operating exercise, and include the entire source directory or ZIP in the same final saved application artifact. In standalone mode, materialize the exact Library helpers and retain the returned Library identity.
integration.library_import: from library_upload import LibraryUploadWorkflow, HostedAppsClient, LibraryFileMaterializer, SignedUrlUploader
integration.public_gis: Anonymous GET requests follow the officially linked lccgis portal, paginate its public catalog to nextStart=-1, and retrieve every identifier for each selected infrastructure or recreation layer. Original pages, selected identifiers, returned attributes/geometry and source changes are preserved. Raw feature pages remain separate, each within the application's 32 MiB per-file boundary. Layer files contain the full identifier/page manifest and schema instead of repeating all geometry in one large JSON file. Oversized query responses are split by the original requested identifiers. Original queries request the published service coordinate system with Z and M retained. Identifier coverage is recorded separately from published edit-marker consistency; absent markers remain unknown, and their absence does not discard the received features.
integration.source_notes: The collector contains the complete GIS reader; no additional Python GIS package is required. PDF text uses installed pdftotext, otherwise pypdf. A PDF extraction error preserves the complete original PDF.
integration.original_capture_reuse: A nonblocking directory lock serializes capture. Startup verifies retained source receipts and original byte hashes, rejects key-to-URL changes, and reuses existing source outcomes. A completed capture seals the source selection, archive and full member inventory; later invocations verify and reopen that original edition without public reads, archive replacement or a new save. Select a fresh output directory for a later acquisition edition.
integration.facility_directory_coverage: The facility directory observations identify first-page coverage; this collector does not claim directory pagination.
